<description>
**Problem:** Loading a UTXO snapshot on a pruned node can leave the active tip without block or undo data. Attempting a rollback with `dumptxoutset` then triggers an assertion and terminates the node.

**Fix:** Reuse `GetPruneHeight` to reject rollback with the existing pruning error when the required data is unavailable.
</description>

<commits>
a2996510e8 test: characterize snapshot rollback without tip data

Record the assertion when the snapshot tip lacks block data or undo, then restart the node to continue the existing checks.

8c81459873 rpc: reject snapshot rollback without tip data

Reuse GetPruneHeight to return the existing pruning error when the snapshot tip lacks block or undo data.

4b3849d53b rpc: check block and undo data above rollback target

Rollback disconnects only blocks above the requested height. Check those blocks for missing body or undo data before copying the UTXO set on pruned nodes and snapshot chainstates.
Report unavailable data because snapshot history may not yet have been downloaded.

Suggested in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36503#pullrequestreview-5492606225
</commits>

     } else {
-        // Check pruning constraints before attempting rollback and prevent
-        // pruning of the necessary blocks with a temporary prune lock
+        // Check that the blocks to disconnect are available and protect them from pruning
+        BlockManager& blockman{node.chainman->m_blockman};
         std::optional<TemporaryPruneLock> temp_prune_lock;
-        if (node.chainman->m_blockman.IsPruneMode()) {
+        if (const bool prune_mode{blockman.IsPruneMode()}; prune_mode || chainstate.m_from_snapshot_blockhash) {
             LOCK(node.chainman->GetMutex());
-            const CBlockIndex* current_tip{node.chainman->ActiveChain().Tip()};
-            const CBlockIndex& first_block{node.chainman->m_blockman.GetFirstBlock(*current_tip, /*status_mask=*/BLOCK_HAVE_MASK)};
-            if (first_block.nHeight > target_index->nHeight) {
-                throw JSONRPCError(RPC_MISC_ERROR, "Could not roll back to requested height since necessary block data is already pruned.");
+            if (GetPruneHeight(blockman, chainstate.m_chain).value_or(0) > target_index->nHeight) {
+                throw JSONRPCError(RPC_MISC_ERROR, "Could not roll back to requested height because required block or undo data is unavailable.");
             }
-            temp_prune_lock.emplace(node.chainman->m_blockman, target_index->nHeight);
+            if (prune_mode) temp_prune_lock.emplace(blockman, target_index->nHeight);
         }

@@ -677,6 +687,17 @@ class AssumeutxoTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         snapshot_block = n0.getblock(snapshot_hash, 0)

+        self.log.info("Check snapshot rollback through the snapshot block, which has no undo data")
